correctness.rationale: The published diagonal interrupter MM*=M*PM with P_nn=(n+1)(n+2)/[(n+3)(n+4)] gives K=M*RM≥0, R_nn=(4n+10)/[(n+3)(n+4)]; B=√R M is Hilbert–Schmidt by O(n^-2) weighted row-energy so K trace-class. (MM*)_nl=2(3max(n,l)−min(n,l)+3)/[3(max+1)(max+2)]. Consequently Tr(K²)=Σ_{n,l}r_n r_l G_nl² absolutely; group n=max terms, evaluate Σ_{l<n}r_l l^j, j=0,1,2, by partial fractions, obtaining T_n=A_nH_{n+2}+D_n. Group simple poles before infinite summation, apply Σ H_j/j²=2ζ(3), harmonic generating function integrals, and ζ(2)=π²/6 to evaluate the exact closed expression. Independent exact Fraction checks reproduced 70 finite Gram/partial fraction terms, and mpmath confirmed a positive 70-term truncation and total 3.576886080095425..., but only the analytic convergent summations prove the infinite value.
